CleanupRequest.description:
Which ended runs a cleanup removes.

Attributes:
    older_than_days: Runs which ended at least this many days ago.
    group: Only the runs of this group.
    failed_only: Only failed runs.
    dry_run: List what would be removed, remove nothing.
CleanupRequest.title: CleanupRequest

CleanupResult.description: What a cleanup or a deletion removed, paths relative to the store.
CleanupResult.title: CleanupResult

CompareTable.description:
A table of runs.

Attributes:
    columns: The columns in order: `run`, `group`, `agent`, `state`, then per
        source `<source>.changed_files` and `<source>.diff_sha256`, then every
        key of `out/summary.json` of every task as `<task>.<key>`.
    rows: One row per run, with every column (None where a run has no value).
CompareTable.title: CompareTable

EditRequest.description:
A request of the browser to the command.

Attributes:
    id: Id of the request.
    kind: `save` writes the file, `run` submits the workflow.
    workflow: The workflow of the draft.
    base: For a save, the hash of the file the draft started from.
    force: Save although the file changed on disk.
    group: Group of the run.
    split: Split mode of the run.
    reserve: Node reserved for the run.
    created: When the request was made.
EditRequest.title: EditRequest

EditResult.description:
The answer of the command to a request.

Attributes:
    ok: Whether the request was done.
    status: The status of a refusal, 4xx or 5xx: 409 conflict, 422 refused.
    detail: The reason of a refusal.
    file_sha256: For a save, the hash of the written file.
    run: For a run, the submitted run.
EditResult.title: EditResult

EditSession.description:
An edit session.

Attributes:
    id: Id of the session.
    owner: The user of the token which opened it.
    host: The machine of the command.
    path: The absolute path of the workflow file there.
    workflow: The workflow as in the file.
    file_sha256: Hash of the file content, empty for a file which does not exist.
    sources: The provenance of the last snapshots.
    tree: Per source the state of the working tree.
    created: When the session was opened.
    seen: The last poll of the command.
    closed: The command stopped.
    connected: Not closed and seen lately; computed when read.
EditSession.title: EditSession

EditState.description: What the command read from disk, sent when it changed.
EditState.title: EditState

HintView.description: The default resources of a task type.
HintView.title: HintView

Identity.description:
Who calls the service: a person or an agent acting for a person.

Attributes:
    name: Name of the person or the agent.
    kind: `person` or `agent`.
    owner: The person responsible; a person's owner is the person.
Identity.title: Identity

LedgerCounts.description: The number of units per state.
LedgerCounts.title: LedgerCounts

OpenEdit.description: The body which opens a session.
OpenEdit.title: OpenEdit

OutputFile.description: A file of the output of a task, its path relative to the store.
OutputFile.title: OutputFile

PodShape.description:
The resources of a worker pod.

Attributes:
    cores: Number of cores.
    memory_gb: Memory in GiB, rounded up.
    processes: Number of worker processes.
    per_worker_gb: Memory per worker process in GiB.
    retry_memory_gb: Memory of a retry in GiB.
    retry_per_worker_gb: Memory per worker process of a retry in GiB.
    scratch_gb: Local scratch in GiB.
    gpus: Number of GPUs.
PodShape.title: PodShape

PodUsage.description:
A pod of a run on a server.

Attributes:
    run_id: The run of the pod, None when the pod belongs to no known run.
    task_id: The task of the pod.
    pod: The name of the pod.
    phase: The phase of the pod.
    cores: The cores it requests.
    memory_gb: The GiB of memory it requests.
PodUsage.title: PodUsage

Priority.description: The priority of a run in the queue.
Priority.title: Priority

ResolvedResources.description:
The resources requested for a task.

Attributes:
    memory_base_gb: Base memory in GiB.
    memory_per_worker_gb: Memory per worker in GiB.
    scratch_gb: Local scratch in GiB.
    gpus: Number of GPUs.
    seconds_per_unit: Median seconds of a unit in one process, None without
        records.
    samples: Number of memory observations the memory was learned from.
    source: `learned from N runs`, `plugin hint`, `default` or `override`.
ResolvedResources.title: ResolvedResources

ResourceOverride.description: Resources of a task which replace the learned or default ones.
ResourceOverride.title: ResourceOverride

RunBody.description: The body of a run, with the options of `SubmitRequest`.
RunBody.title: RunBody

RunItem.description:
A run of the list of runs: its summary with its owner and workflow name.

Attributes:
    owner: The owner of the run, of an agent the person it acts for.
    workflow: The name of the workflow.
    progress: The progress of an active run (submitting, queued, running) from
        0 to 1, from the states of its tasks and their ledgers (`run_progress`);
        None for a run which ended.
RunItem.title: RunItem

RunRecord.description:
The record of a run.

Attributes:
    id: Run id, `YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<6 hex>`.
    submitted_by: Submitting user.
    owner: Owner of the run.
    agent: Agent which submitted the run.
    priority: Priority in the queue.
    group: Group of the run.
    workflow: The workflow.
    sources: Provenance of the snapshots of the sources.
    image: Container image.
    reserve: Reservation.
    state: State of the run.
    tasks: State of every task.
    plans: The task plans as dicts.
    backend_name: Name of the backend workflow.
    created: Time of creation.
    built: Time the image of the run was ready and the submission of its workflow
        began, None while its environment is resolved and built.
    finished: Time of the end.
    message: A message, e.g. the failure.
    oom_kills: The attempts of the pods killed for memory per worker (the worker
        id, the task id of an unsplit task, `<task>-merge` of a merge).
    merge_pending: The time the service first saw the coordinator of a split task
        which merges succeeded without the marker of its merge, by task id; the
        task waits for the marker until `MERGE_MARKER_GRACE_S` of
        `simrun.service.controller` after it.
    pending_release: A reserved node whose release failed, retried by the service.
    pending_cancel: Whether the workflow must still be cancelled, e.g. one which
        may have been created by a submission that failed.
    pending_logs: Whether the logs of the pods of an ended run must still be
        kept in the store (`simrun.service.logs`).
    local_commands: How the local backend runs the `command` tasks of the run:
        `direct` its args, `docker` in its image; None the choice of the
        backend. The Argo backend ignores it.
RunRecord.title: RunRecord

RunSummary.description: The state of a run without its workflow and plans.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

ServerUsage.description:
A server of the cluster with the pods of runs on it.

Attributes:
    name: The name of the server.
    cores: The cores the scheduler gives the pods of the runs: the allocatable
        ones less the requests of other pods, e.g. of DaemonSets.
    memory_gb: The GiB of memory the scheduler gives the pods of the runs.
    gpus: The GPUs of the server.
    reserved_by: The run which reserved the server, None if free.
    pods: The pods of runs on the server, with their requests, which count
        against `cores` and `memory_gb`.
ServerUsage.title: ServerUsage

SourceProvenance.description:
Where the files of a snapshot come from.

Attributes:
    name: Name of the source.
    branch: Branch of the working tree, `None` for a detached HEAD.
    commit: Commit of HEAD.
    dirty: Whether the working tree differs from HEAD.
    changed_files: Porcelain status lines, e.g. `M src/a.py`.
    diff_sha256: Hash of the snapshot tree (paths, types, modes, contents);
        the patch stays as provenance.
    snapshot: Directory of the snapshot, relative to the store root.
    patch: Stored `git diff HEAD --binary`, relative to the store root.
SourceProvenance.title: SourceProvenance

SplitMode.description: How the pieces of a task are placed on the nodes.
SplitMode.title: SplitMode

SubmitRequest.description:
A submission of a workflow.

Attributes:
    workflow: The workflow.
    sources: The snapshots of the sources, the model first.
    group: Group of the run, e.g. a study.
    split: Split mode of every task, else the one of the task or the workflow.
    reserve: A node reserved for the run, else the one of the workflow.
    local_commands: How the local backend runs the `command` tasks: `direct`
        their args, `docker` in their images; None the choice of the backend.
        The Argo backend ignores it.
SubmitRequest.title: SubmitRequest

TaskEstimate.description:
The resources, the plan and the expected duration of a task.

Attributes:
    resources: The resolved resources.
    plan: The plan of the pods.
    seconds: The expected seconds of a split task: the median time of a unit in
        one process of past runs times the rounds of its units over the
        processes of its pods, None without past runs.
TaskEstimate.title: TaskEstimate

TaskPlan.description:
The plan of a task.

Attributes:
    task_id: Id of the task.
    pods: Number of worker pods.
    shape: Shape of a pod.
    base_priority: Priority class of the first pods.
    extra_priority: Priority class of the further pods.
    units: Number of units, None for an unsplit task.
    coordinator_merges: Whether the coordinator of a split task merges once its
        ledger is complete, so the task has no merge pod. False for plans
        recorded before the merge moved into the coordinator.
TaskPlan.title: TaskPlan

TaskProgress.description:
The progress of a task: its ledger and the first and last lines of its progress file.

The first line is the first unit done, whose time is when the task began to
deliver units.
TaskProgress.title: TaskProgress

TaskSpec.description:
A task of a workflow.

Attributes:
    id: Identifier of the task within the workflow.
    type: Name of the task plugin.
    settings: Settings handed to the plugin.
    inputs: Input port to the output of another task, `<task>.<port>`.
    split: Split mode of the task, the one of the workflow by default.
    resources: Resources replacing the learned or default ones.
    stage: Input ports copied to local scratch.
TaskSpec.title: TaskSpec

TaskState.description: State of a task of a run.
TaskState.title: TaskState

TaskTypeView.description: A task type with the JSON Schema of its settings, for the editor.
TaskTypeView.title: TaskTypeView

TreeState.description:
The live state of the working tree of a source.

Attributes:
    name: Name of the source.
    branch: The branch, none when detached.
    commit: The commit.
    changed_files: The files which differ from the commit.
TreeState.title: TreeState

Usage.description: Bytes of the run store per run and per group (`""` without a group).
Usage.title: Usage

ValidationResult.description: The result of a validation: the errors of a workflow, none when valid.
ValidationResult.title: ValidationResult

WorkerView.description:
A worker of a task, from its reports, its pod and its claims.

Attributes:
    worker: The worker id.
    node: The server of the attempt shown: of the live pod while it runs,
        None while that pod is not bound, else of the last report.
    state: `running` while a pod of an attempt without a report lives (a
        retry after an eviction, a preemption, a lost node or a kill for
        memory, as a worker reports also when it is stopped), else from the
        last report: `failed` when it was killed for memory, else `done`.
    attempts: The attempts of the worker: one more than the highest attempt
        of its reports and of its live pod.
    processes: The processes of its pool, None before a report.
    units_done: The distinct units its `unit_done` lines in the progress
        file of the task name, live and over all its attempts.
    units_claimed: The units it holds claimed now.
    peak_memory_gb: The peak memory of the last report.
    memory_limit_gb: The memory limit of the last report.
    oom_killed: Whether the attempt of the last report was killed for memory.
WorkerView.title: WorkerView

Workflow.description: A workflow: tasks which read the outputs of each other.
Workflow.title: Workflow

post.description:
Write a snapshot from a scan and a tar of the files the store lacks.

The multipart body has `scan`, the `Scan` as JSON, and `files`, the tar.
422 for a name, a path, a member or a hash which is not the one of a tree,
409 for a file whose content neither the tar nor the store has (ask again
which are missing), 413 for a body above `max_upload_bytes`.

files.description: a tar of the files the store lacks

scan.description: the Scan of the tree as JSON

post.description:
The paths of the files whose content the store lacks.

The body is the list of the `FileEntry` of a scan. The files whose content
the latest snapshot of `name` has are linked to it by the upload; the
client sends the others. 422 for a name or a path which is not one of a
tree, 413 for a list above `FILE_LIST_MAX_BYTES`.

items.description:
A file of a working tree as a snapshot holds it.

Attributes:
    path: Path below the tree, with `/`.
    mode: Mode bits without the write bits (a snapshot is read-only), special
        bits kept as release 0.1.0 kept them; the ones of the link for a
        symbolic link.
    sha256: Hash of the content of a regular file, None for a link.
    link: Target of a symbolic link, None for a regular file.
items.title: FileEntry
